subject: GreenBridge pilot: request for subprocessor authorizations and sandbox evidence
messages:
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@greenbridge.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: subprocessor authorizations + sandbox evidence for pilot

Hi Elliot,

Hope you’re well. As we get ready to start the GreenBridge pilot next week, Security has a few outstanding asks to complete our onboarding checklist: 

1) Complete subprocessor roster with onboarding evidence — for each subprocessor we need: contract clause reference (DPA clause), country of processing, and a short proof artifact (SOC2 excerpt, attestation letter, or audit snapshot).
2) A compact “fingerprint” for each processor — a short human-readable identifier we can reference in our tracker (e.g., ZIP name or hash tag) so we can map certs to roster rows.
3) Temporary sandbox endpoint and credentials that demonstrate EU-region routing for a subset of test traffic. We only need this for 48 hours.

Can you send the roster and a bundled package of proofs, plus an ETA? Our legal/compliance review is on a tight timeline (need by end of week).

Thanks — Sarah
Security Program Manager
GreenBridge Financial

---
Attaching the pilot statement of work in a separate message (will forward to your legal team).

From: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@greenbridge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor authorizations + sandbox evidence for pilot

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and the checklist.

Acknowledged. I’m looping in Kimberly (Legal) and Marcus (Infra) to pull together the roster, the proofs bundle, and a short-lived EU sandbox.

Action items:
- Kimberly: can Legal confirm whether a DPA addendum is required or if our standard DPA covers the temporary sandbox proof-of-routing?
- Marcus: can Infra prepare a 48-hour EU sandbox URL and a minimal set of creds; also include a short note about routing guarantees and log retention for the window.

I’ll consolidate everything into a single package and send to you as soon as we have the artifacts (target: 2026-08-28 COB).

Best,
Elliot Price
Account Lead, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-26T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor authorizations + sandbox evidence for pilot

Elliot — quick note from Legal.

We can supply a DPA addendum if GreenBridge requires express reference to the sandbox/testing window; however, for short-lived demonstration environments our standard DPA (section 3.2 - Subprocessors) already covers disclosure and proof artifacts. 

To make the review quicker on their side:
- We will include a DPA addendum template (editable) that explicitly lists the temporary sandbox entry and timeframe. 
- For each subprocessor row please include: name, country, processing role, DPA clause reference (3.2 or addendum line), artifact filename, and a compact fingerprint. Use GUID-like short IDs (e.g., RBW-SUB-001) rather than hashes — compliance prefers human-readable tags.
- Confirm that artifacts are redacted to remove operational secrets (we accept attestation PDFs, SOC2 excerpts, or ISO cert snapshots).

I’ll attach the template now and can review GreenBridge’s redlines directly if they send them.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Contracts
Redwood Inference

- Roster contains 7 subprocessors. Each row uses the recommended ID format (RBW-SUB-001 .. RBW-SUB-007).
- All artifacts are redacted and packaged in onboarding_proofs_bundle.zip; included is a short manifest mapping artifact filenames to roster IDs.

- Internal ticket: INF-4572 documents the provisioning steps and the temporary creds rotation.

Next steps: happy to upload the bundle to a shared Drive and provide download/docusign links. Marcus will also provide a single-slide test plan if GreenBridge wants a walkthrough.

Marcus Lin
Principal Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

Hi Sarah — team update and attached package.

What’s included (bundle):
- subprocessor_roster_20260825.csv (7 rows, IDs RBW-SUB-001..007)
- onboarding_proofs_bundle.zip (redacted attestation PDFs + SOC2 excerpts)
- DPA_addendum_template.docx (editable addendum we can sign if you require explicit mention of the sandbox)
- sandbox_credentials.txt (one-time creds; sandbox URL: https://eu-sandbox-002.redwood-inference.net; window: 2026-08-28 08:00 UTC -> 2026-08-30 08:00 UTC)

A few notes:
- The roster uses the RBW-SUB-* fingerprint IDs Kimberly suggested. Those are the compact identifiers you can import into your tracker.
- Marcus confirmed routing to Frankfurt and included a log snapshot inside the proofs bundle showing X-Redwood-Region: eu-central-1 for a test request.
- Legal: Kim attached an addendum template — please let us know if GreenBridge would like us to execute the addendum before you run the sandbox. Given the short window, we’re fine executing a quick addendum if that expedites your review; otherwise our standard DPA covers these artifacts.

Next actions:
1) Please confirm receipt and whether you want the addendum executed.
2) If you’d like a quick walkthrough we can schedule a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk the test plan and look at logs.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the pilot running.

Best,
Elliot Price
Account Lead, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: subprocessor_roster_20260825.csv, onboarding_proofs_bundle.zip, DPA_addendum_template.docx, sandbox_credentials.txt
